_comment: Shared normalization fixture for the Pulse / Ask recent-work window (#1086). Read by BOTH
tests/test_pulse_window.py and web/src/lib/recentWindow.test.ts so the Python and TypeScript
rules cannot drift. READ is lenient and CLAMPS (a stored 7 reads as 3 — a deliberate change
from the old fall-back-to-default read); WRITE is strict (422, never coerce). Booleans are
rejected on TYPE, since isinstance(True, int) is True in Python.
JSON cannot express NaN / Infinity; each suite adds those in its own language.

read.why: an old 1–30 value CLAMPS to the new max, it does not reset
half rounds away from zero: floor(x + 0.5)
a boolean is not a number of days
a boolean is not a number of days
a string is not a number
past float range: JS reads Infinity, Python reads inf
a 400-digit INTEGER: JS reads Infinity; Python must not raise converting it (review 5044)
